annotations.title: Where does this company's revenue come from, and how is the mix moving?

description: Use when the user names a public company and asks how its revenue splits (by platform, revenue type, channel, product or region) or whether its mix is shifting, for example toward mobile, live services or digital. Returns every revenue split the company files that adds up to reported revenue across its three latest 10-Ks, with each fiscal year's shares and dollar values and each filing's citation, from SEC EDGAR XBRL as filed. If the company files no split this run can verify, it refuses before you are charged. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For dependence on one customer, use run_customer_concentration; for margins against peers, use run_peer_benchmark.
